cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
PROJECT=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; DATASET=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']; LOCATION=os.environ['GCP_LOCATION']
bq=bigquery.Client(project=PROJECT, location=LOCATION)
ds=f'{PROJECT}.{DATASET}'
sql=f'''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`{ds}.scaled_source\` AS
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(f1) m1, AVG(f2) m2, AVG(f3) m3, AVG(f4) m4,
         STDDEV_POP(f1) s1, STDDEV_POP(f2) s2, STDDEV_POP(f3) s3, STDDEV_POP(f4) s4
  FROM \`{ds}.features_train\`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM \`{ds}.features_train\`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM \`{ds}.features_serve\`
)
SELECT c.row_id, c.split,
  ROUND((c.f1-s.m1)/s.s1,6) AS f1,
  ROUND((c.f2-s.m2)/s.s2,6) AS f2,
  ROUND((c.f3-s.m3)/s.s3,6) AS f3,
  ROUND((c.f4-s.m4)/s.s4,6) AS f4,
  TIMESTAMP('2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC') AS feature_timestamp
FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s
'''
bq.query(sql, location=LOCATION).result()
t=bq.get_table(f'{ds}.scaled_source')
print('scaled_source rows:', t.num_rows)
for r in bq.query(f'SELECT split, COUNT(*) n FROM \`{ds}.scaled_source\` GROUP BY split ORDER BY split', location=LOCATION).result():

for r in bq.query(f'SELECT * FROM \`{ds}.scaled_source\` ORDER BY row_id LIMIT 3', location=LOCATION).result():
